line: A body cut open as a factory that runs backwards: a 12:30 sandwich is taken apart station by station, and six hours later it runs for the bus.
line_cn: 把人体剖成一座倒着开的工厂：12:30 的一份三明治被一站一站拆开，六小时后变成追公交车的力气。

camera.serves: an opening; moving between stations on one floor
the intake; going inside a part

camera.move: Tilt down a chute, slabs wiping past
Pull back from a part to the whole floor
camera.serves: a sorting or splitting station; a held comparison
where one product goes while the others leave frame
a trigger, an alarm, a customer, an event
a demand that must be met now
the ending: the full silhouette with every station lit

transitions: Transitions happen inside the drawing: passing through a shape, floor slabs wiping the frame, a match cut on the same piece of cargo, a colour follow, a circular porthole mask, a whip along a pipe (directional motion blur from the camera's speed plus speed lines, rendered once, never stacked ghosts).
labels: Three faces, three jobs (all OFL): a condensed industrial display face for plaques, legend tags and the title (Big Shoulders Display 800–900, like letters painted on a factory wall); a grotesque for small labels, subtitles and credits (Archivo 600–800); a CJK sans for the one short Chinese line on each sign (Noto Sans SC 700, at least 34 px).
Plaques: cream board, 2.6 px ink frame, 3 px corners, flat shadow; [number circle] [ENGLISH METAPHOR | 中文名], stuck on the room's top edge or on the machine, never on a leader line.
Legend tags hang above their line: a colour chip, then the English and Chinese name (GLASS 玻璃).
Leaders (Holmes): dot → vertical → right angle → bold words, only for a moving hero, at most one per frame.
motion: The belt never stops moving; cargo travels at constant speed and eases into stations.

A station starts on arrival. Its machine starts on the beat the cargo lands (rollers turn, sprays fall, a press stamps), its worker does a two-frame action, its number circle fills and pops (scale 0.9 → 1 with overshoot).
Signs drop on chains and bounce once; a second-language sign swings in half a beat later.
Repetition is the joke. A gatekeeper raises STOP, lets one portion through, raises STOP again; machines repeat their cycle on the music's grid.

native_moves.name: Station starts
native_moves.does: Cargo lands, the machine starts, the worker acts, the number fills.
native_moves.fits: each step of a manufacturing process; each stage of a data pipeline; each department a request passes through.

native_moves.name: Taking it apart into colours
native_moves.does: One lump enters a sorting floor and leaves as three streams of differently coloured parts, each into its own pipe, with legend tags dropping over them.
native_moves.fits: a mail sack into postcodes; crude oil into fractions; revenue into costs; ore into metals.

native_moves.name: Gatekeeper
native_moves.does: A worker with a STOP sign lets one portion through at a time.
native_moves.fits: a valve, a rate limit, a queue, a customs desk, a dam.

native_moves.name: Warehouse and clock
native_moves.does: Goods are shelved; the clock spins; the lights dim; workers doze until an alarm.
native_moves.fits: energy storage, inventory, a battery, savings.

native_moves.name: Porthole alarm
native_moves.does: A circular POV on the outside world shows the event that sets the line running.
native_moves.fits: demand arriving, an order, a sensor trigger.

native_moves.name: Follow the colour
native_moves.does: The camera picks one pipe by colour and rides it to its destination while the others turn away.
native_moves.fits: where one product goes; one signal's route; one customer's journey.

native_moves.name: Light the whole line
native_moves.does: The great pull-back to the full silhouette; a glow runs from intake to output and the numbers pop in order.
native_moves.fits: the summary of any process; a product's whole life; an ending.

score.note: a march the stations add voices to; woodblock and bass drum on presses
